name: VS Code App for AoU
description: A template used to serve code-server (VS Code) for AoU, with egress rate limiting and policy reminders

login.description: Whether to log in to workbench CLI

workspaceTrust.description: Whether VS Code workspace trust (Restricted Mode) is enabled. Set to false so extensions that do not support untrusted workspaces, such as the CSV editor, work.

shmSize.description: Shared memory size for the application-server container

memoryLimit.description: Memory limit for the application-server container
